Elena / Tom — thanks for the fast turnaround and for sending GoodLaw's annotations. Short answers below and next steps.

1) Retention carveout (7 years): Redwood can accept a timeboxed clinical-retention exception conditioned on (a) documented minimization plan, (b) per-record TTL controls, and (c) KMS audit logs provided within 21 days of request. This will be captured in a limited DPA addendum clause (see attached redline v1 where I added a retention carveout comment).

2) UK Addendum / SCCs: Laura is validating whether the SCCs mapping requires the formal UK Addendum. Initial read: likely yes for UK residency requests; Laura will confirm clause numbers by EOD Mon (6/8). If the UK Addendum is required, Ben's escalation plan stands — procurement signoff will be needed for any hosting or SSO/KMS configuration changes.

3) KMS proof / export controls: We can provide KMS attestation and export-control evidence. GoodLaw — will Fusio accept Redwood's proposed attestation timeline (KMS audit logs within 21 days)? If yes, we'll add the language.

Action items / owners:
- Laura: SCCs clause numbers + confirmation about UK Addendum (due 6/08).
- Ben: Prepare procurement memo if the UK Addendum is required (due 6/08).
- Marissa: Send combined redline + SCCs_annotated_GoodLaw.pdf to GoodLaw and Fusio on 6/05 (please include the DocuSign preamble).

DocuSign packet & links: We will only prepare DocuSign if no further redline substance is requested by 6/08. Draft DocuSign PowerForm: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abcd-1234
